notes: Minimum age is 16 per the page. Listings change, so check the careers tool for current postings.
name: Sandia National Laboratories High School Internships
what_you_do: High school students work on real tech or business projects. Mentors help them. Sandia has posted Technical High School internships (summer and year round) in areas like mechanical design.
who_can_apply: At least 16 years old. Full-time enrolled high school students with a cumulative GPA of at least 3.0 for research, technical or business jobs (2.5 for clerical or laborer jobs). Some jobs need U.S. citizenship.
duration: Summer or year round. During the school year, high school students work up to 25 hours a week.
deadline_text: Jobs are posted one by one on Sandia's careers site. Each has its own dates.
how_to_apply: Make a username on Sandia's careers site. Filter for Student jobs. Apply to each internship on its own. A student guide PDF is linked on the page.
